description:
Every surface that reports an issue's documents shows its derived documents, so an artifact under an issue's directory counts as linked everywhere, with no tracker write.

## Background

66986f88 made `jit doc list` derive an issue's documents from its artifact directories, through `derive_issue_documents` in `crates/jit/src/domain/artifact_directory.rs`. `jit issue show`, the `JIT_ISSUE_DOCS` value gates receive and the issue JSON the web UI reads still list explicit links only. On epic 3d9a0ce3 today, `doc list` shows 11 documents and `issue show` shows 1. Epic REQ-03 says such an artifact is linked to the issue after merge with no further tracker write; a reader of `issue show` or a gate cannot see that link.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `jit issue show`, the `JIT_ISSUE_DOCS` value and the server's issue reads report the same document set as `jit doc list`, explicit and derived, through `derive_issue_documents` with no second derivation (`@/charter/D-20`).
- [hard] REQ-02: A derived document carries no type and no label, and stored issue records are unchanged: nothing derived is written.
- [hard] REQ-03: A repository that declares no documentation areas reports explicit links only.
- [hard] REQ-04: One test owns the agreement between those surfaces; the web UI is updated if its type declares a required field that a derived document lacks.
title: Report derived documents on every issue surface
